name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 33 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-11-01, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
